purpose: check, against named rules, that the system and the way it is built and run meet legal, regulatory and contractual obligations, and keep the evidence
entry_criteria: Controls exist and are in operation
Evidence is accessible to the reviewer
inputs: system evidence such as configurations, logs and records
procedure: Select the obligations in scope and break each into testable control statements.
Gather evidence for each control from the system itself (configurations, access lists, logs, tickets) rather than from descriptions alone.
Test a sample for operation over the period, not only the design: for example, a sample of changes for approval records.
Classify results: compliant, partly compliant, non-compliant or not applicable, with the evidence reference.
Raise each gap with an owner, a remediation and a date, and record accepted risks with an approver.
Report to the compliance owner, and retest remediations before closing.
deliverables: control test matrix with evidence references
acceptance_criteria: Each in-scope obligation has a control and a result
Evidence comes from the system, not only from descriptions
validation_method: Compliance owner accepts the report; named executive accepts residual risk.

validation.check: sample 10 changes from the period and check each for approval and test records
check each non-compliant row has an owner and a date

failure_modes.mode: Risk accepted by a team member

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A review of an access-review obligation samples four quarters and finds one missing; it is raised as a gap with an owner, completed within 30 days, and the new record is added to the evidence.
